key_highlights: ASX positioned for positive open following Wall Street tech rally and rebound in AI equities.
ANZ Banking Group (ANZ.AX) reported strong full-year cash profit ($7.3B–$7.6B) driven by cost-efficiency programs.
Macro headwinds persist as Australia experiences its steepest housing downturn alongside RBA rate pressure and stagnant GDP.
Aviation sector under pressure as Qantas (QAN.AX) flags $1B fuel cost increase, prompting fare hikes and route trimming.

sectors.trend: Bank earnings resilience buoyed by productivity gains, offset by household mortgage stress.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX cost-reduction success supports dividend stability, but accelerating mortgage stress and housing price declines threaten net interest margins and credit growth.

sectors.trend: Positive sentiment returning to tech infrastructure following US AI momentum recovery.
sectors.implications: Global AI rebound provides positive tailwinds for domestic digital infrastructure leaders like NEXTDC (NXT.AX), balancing headline risks in offshore semiconductor supply chains.

sectors.trend: Resurgent equity financing in gold and critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: Strong broker-backed capital raisings in gold equities and early-stage lithium ventures (BPM.AX) reflect targeted resource speculation, while iron ore outlook hinges on China stimulus.

sectors.trend: Subdued crude pricing outlook juxtaposed against immediate aviation fuel margin squeeze.
sectors.implications: Higher refined jet fuel expenses impose a $1B headwind on Qantas (QAN.AX), enforcing capacity discipline, while upstream energy producers (WDS.AX) face a slow oil price recovery.

sectors.trend: Department store contraction and national residential housing downturn weighing on asset values.
sectors.implications: Traditional mall REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) face anchor tenancy transition risks post-David Jones distress; falling property wealth tightens consumer discretionary spending.

key_themes: Divergence between global tech/equity resilience and deteriorating domestic Australian economic indicators.
Corporate cost reduction and pricing power serving as key differentiators amid lingering inflation.
Deepening residential property downturn mirroring historical international crash trajectories.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight domestic mortgage-exposed banks and residential housing cyclicals; rotate toward offshore-earning defensive equities.
Avoid margin-compressed transport operators lacking pricing power; favor infrastructure and staples with direct inflation-linked revenue.
Maintain allocations in defensive healthcare (CSL.AX) and quality consumer staples (WOW.AX) resilient to low-growth environments.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Retail Anchor Vacancy and Mall Re-Rating
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favor industrial and logistics real estate (GMG.AX) over retail mall REITs exposed to legacy department store distress.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate data centre and AI infrastructure providers on dips.
opportunities.rationale: Global technology stabilization and resilient enterprise AI investment support sustained demand for domestic data centre capacity.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on institutional appetite in liquid gold producers.
opportunities.rationale: Elevated gold capital raising activity signals robust institutional backing and attractive safe-haven macro positioning.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical trading in cost-disciplined major banks.
opportunities.rationale: ANZ.AX shows operational resilience via cost reductions, supporting near-term capital management and dividend yields.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to airline and discretionary transport operators.
defensive_moves.rationale: A $1B surge in jet fuel costs and consumer price resistance threaten margin compression and volume contraction.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight retail REITs vulnerable to anchor tenant attrition.
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural challenges at department store anchors weaken foot traffic and net operating income for regional shopping malls.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge broad ASX equity index exposure against domestic stagnation.
defensive_moves.rationale: Elevated RBA cash rate settings and negligible domestic GDP growth limit multiple expansion across broader equities.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 expected to track global risk sentiment higher in the immediate term, supported by tech and bank earnings, but capped near overhead resistance by domestic growth concerns.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term performance constrained by Australia's deepening housing downturn, consumer debt pressures, and restrictive RBA monetary settings before eventual policy easing.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and cash rate trajectory commentary
Australian quarterly GDP, retail sales, and headline/trimmed-mean CPI releases
Global AI and technology earnings guidance updates
Crude oil price trends and Singapore jet fuel crack spreads
watch_list: AUD/USD response to US policy shifts and commodity demand
CoreLogic national housing value indices and mortgage distress levels
Major bank net interest margin trends and bad debt provisioning
Iron ore benchmark prices (SGX 62% Fe) and Chinese stimulus implementation
